name: Finding the Antidote
label: Quest
description: Finding the Antidote is an urgent task undertaken for Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar to brew a cure for the poisoned hunter Rhinag. Facing a strict deadline…
intro: Finding the Antidote is an urgent task undertaken for Kor'ghan in Orgrimmar to brew a cure for the poisoned hunter Rhinag. Facing a strict deadline before the venom proves fatal, an adventurer must gather venomtail poison sacs from scorpids outside the city walls. It highlights the unforgiving nature of Durotar's wildlife and the necessity of wilderness preparation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Venomtails are some of the deadliest scorpids in Durotar. It was unwise for Rhinag to hunt them without having some of the antidote with him, but right now, chastising is the last thing he needs.
Bring me a few venomtail poison sacs from any of the venomtails near the entrance of Orgrimmar and I'll make an antidote for him.
Make haste, friend. One of our own needs your help.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Remember, no matter what creature you hunt, you would do well to study it and understand its behavior. That knowledge could save your life.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is the antidote, friend. Take it to Rhinag as soon as you can, and be cautious.
